source.snippet: AI agents are exciting. They can research, write, reason, call tools, use APIs, summarize data, and... [12 score, 15 comments on scoping AI MVPs to single workflows]

problem_statement: Founders and product teams building AI-powered SaaS products consistently over-engineer their initial architecture with multiple agents, wasting runway and delaying launch — there is no lightweight scoping or pre-build validation tool that helps them identify the single highest-value workflow to automate first.
target_segment: Early-stage SaaS founders and product managers building AI-native products, typically pre-Series A
notes: Corroborated by dev.to post 'I Understood the Problem. I Still Built the Wrong Product.' (7 score, 13 comments). Both posts signal repeated execution mistakes founders are paying for with runway and time. Buyer profile: founders spending on product development who would pay for a scoping/validation service or checklist tool. Willingness to pay implied by 'costs us runway' framing.
